question.text: A sponsor of a mutual fund must have a sound track record in financial services for a minimum period of:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires a mutual fund sponsor to have a sound track record in financial services for not less than five years. The Trap: 3 years is the operational period for SIF eligibility, not the sponsor track record requirement. Note: Source-backed contrast: 5 years (mutual fund sponsor track record) vs 3 years (SIF operational period).
